itemListElement.name: Avoma Alternatives for US Sales Teams in 2026

mainEntity.name: What is the best alternative to Avoma?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fireflies and Fathom Business are the best lower-cost Avoma alternatives with CRM sync. Gong is the best for enterprise revenue intelligence. Lynkk is the best for call prep, live answers and follow-up tasks.
Avoma's main competitors are Gong, Clari Copilot, Fireflies.ai, Fathom, Otter.ai, Read AI and Lynkk. They range from full revenue platforms to focused note takers.

mainEntity.name: How much does Avoma cost per user?

acceptedAnswer.text: Avoma costs $19 per recorder seat per month on Startup and $29 on Organization, billed yearly. Conversation Intelligence and Revenue Intelligence add-ons cost $29 each per seat billed yearly.
Avoma is better for sales teams that want scheduling, coaching and revenue insight in one tool. Otter is better and cheaper if you mainly need transcripts and summaries.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free Avoma alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Fathom's free plan records unlimited calls, and Lynkk, Otter, Read AI and Fireflies have free plans with limits. Avoma offers a 14-day free trial of its Organization plan.

mainEntity.name: Does Avoma have a free trial?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes.
